note: The property vocabulary every enchanting lane reads (docs/enchanting-contracts.md section 2.2). One entry per book weapon, armour and shield ability, plus the formula-priced wondrous and ring bonuses the book's pricing table names. Every number is the book's, entered by hand; a number that is not the book's is named in the entry's `house` list. `plus` is a bonus equivalent (counts toward the item's total and its capacity), `gp` a flat price outside it, `scaled` a bonus bound at one of `values` and priced bonus squared times `gp_per_square`. `spells` is a list of groups, each group 'any one of these'; each group the binder does not meet is +5 DC, never a refusal (owner, round 1 and round 4 Q4). `requires` restricts the vessel, and the creator clauses are each one more +5 DC. `documents` are effect documents in rules/effectspec.py's vocabulary, applied as printed (`book`); a document naming `choice_key` is filled from the choice stored on the item by effectspec.bind. `not_yet` says, out loud, every clause of the book that nothing executes yet. `aliases` are the old magic-items.json ids, each with the choice it implies, for the migration (lane H). Validated on load by rules/effectspec.properties(); a bad entry stops the load with the fix named.

properties.name: Flaming
not_yet: The book's flame is lit and put out on command; here it is always lit.
properties.text: Sheathed in fire: an extra 1d6 fire damage on every hit. The fire does not harm the wielder.

properties.name: Frost
not_yet: The book's cold is called up and dismissed on command; here it is always present.
properties.text: Sheathed in icy cold: an extra 1d6 cold damage on every hit.

properties.name: Shock
not_yet: The book's lightning is called up and dismissed on command; here it is always present.
properties.text: Sheathed in crackling electricity: an extra 1d6 electricity damage on every hit.

properties.name: Corrosive
not_yet: The book's acid comes and goes on command; here it is always present.
properties.text: Slick with acid: an extra 1d6 acid damage on every hit.

properties.name: Flaming Burst
not_yet: The book's flame is lit on command (the burst works even when it is out); here the flame is always lit.
properties.text: Works as a flaming weapon, and bursts with fire on a critical hit: an extra 1d10 fire (2d10 on a x3 weapon, 3d10 on a x4).

properties.name: Icy Burst
not_yet: The book's cold is called up on command (the burst works even when it is not); here it is always present.
properties.text: Works as a frost weapon, and bursts with cold on a critical hit: an extra 1d10 cold (2d10 on a x3 weapon, 3d10 on a x4).

properties.name: Shocking Burst
not_yet: The book's lightning is called up on command (the burst works even when it is not); here it is always present.
properties.text: Works as a shock weapon, and bursts with lightning on a critical hit: an extra 1d10 electricity (2d10 on a x3 weapon, 3d10 on a x4).

properties.name: Corrosive Burst
not_yet: The book's acid comes on command (the burst works even when it is off); here it is always present.
properties.text: Works as a corrosive weapon, and bursts with acid on a critical hit: an extra 1d10 acid (2d10 on a x3 weapon, 3d10 on a x4).

properties.name: Keen
properties.text: Doubles the weapon's threat range. Only piercing or slashing melee weapons. Does not stack with anything else that widens a threat range.

properties.name: Bane
properties.text: Against one kind of foe, chosen when it is bound, the weapon's enhancement bonus is 2 better and it deals an extra 2d6 damage. Humanoids and outsiders are chosen by subtype.

properties.name: Holy
not_yet: Alignment is not tracked (owner ruling 2026-10-05, round 4 Q7): the creator need not be good, and an evil wielder takes no negative level. Both clauses are kept here as data (`requires.creator_alignment`, `wielder`) and nothing checks them.

The extra 2d6 is `when: target alignment evil`, and Actor._when_holds reads no `alignment` key yet, so it fires against nobody until lane C reads a creature's printed alignment (the bestiary field, as Engine._could_be_evil does for smite).
properties.text: Good-aligned: it passes damage reduction that good passes, and deals an extra 2d6 damage to evil creatures.

properties.name: Unholy
not_yet: Alignment is not tracked (owner ruling 2026-10-05, round 4 Q7): the creator need not be evil, and a good wielder takes no negative level. Both clauses are kept here as data and nothing checks them.
The extra 2d6 is `when: target alignment good`, and Actor._when_holds reads no `alignment` key yet, so it fires against nobody until lane C reads a creature's printed alignment.
properties.text: Evil-aligned: it passes damage reduction that evil passes, and deals an extra 2d6 damage to good creatures.

properties.name: Axiomatic
not_yet: Alignment is not tracked (owner ruling 2026-10-05, round 4 Q7): the creator need not be lawful, and a chaotic wielder takes no negative level. Both clauses are kept here as data and nothing checks them.
The extra 2d6 is `when: target alignment chaotic`, and Actor._when_holds reads no `alignment` key yet, so it fires against nobody until lane C reads a creature's printed alignment.
properties.text: Lawful-aligned: it passes damage reduction that lawful passes, and deals an extra 2d6 damage to chaotic creatures.

properties.name: Anarchic
not_yet: Alignment is not tracked (owner ruling 2026-10-05, round 4 Q7): the creator need not be chaotic, and a lawful wielder takes no negative level. Both clauses are kept here as data and nothing checks them.
The extra 2d6 is `when: target alignment lawful`, and Actor._when_holds reads no `alignment` key yet, so it fires against nobody until lane C reads a creature's printed alignment.
properties.text: Chaotic-aligned: it passes damage reduction that chaotic passes, and deals an extra 2d6 damage to lawful creatures.

properties.name: Ghost Touch
not_yet: An incorporeal creature can pick up and wield a ghost touch weapon; nothing lets an incorporeal creature hold anything yet.
properties.text: Deals full damage to incorporeal creatures, whatever its enhancement bonus.

properties.name: Speed
properties.text: On a full attack, one extra attack with this weapon at full base attack bonus. Not with haste.

properties.name: Defending
properties.text: At the start of each turn the wielder may move some or all of the weapon's enhancement bonus to AC, where it stacks with everything else, until their next turn.

properties.name: Merciful
properties.text: An extra 1d6 damage, and all of it non-lethal. On command it can be suppressed, and then it deals lethal damage without the extra die.

properties.name: Vicious
properties.text: A flash of disruptive energy on every hit: an extra 2d6 damage to the foe, and 1d6 to the wielder. Melee weapons only.

properties.name: Wounding

documents.stopped_by: DC 15 Heal check, or any spell that cures hit point damage

properties.text: Each hit adds 1 point of bleed, taken at the start of the creature's turns, and the bleed grows with every hit. A DC 15 Heal check or any healing spell stops it.

properties.name: Thundering
properties.text: A roar of thunder on a critical hit: an extra 1d8 sonic (2d8 on a x3 weapon, 3d8 on a x4), and Fortitude DC 14 or deafened permanently.

properties.name: Disruption
properties.text: Any undead it strikes must make a DC 14 Will save or be destroyed. Bludgeoning melee weapons only.

properties.name: Vorpal
not_yet: The book's exceptions are 'many aberrations and all oozes' (no head) and 'golems and undead creatures other than vampires' (unaffected). Written here as oozes, constructs and undead: a vampire should lose its head and does not, a construct that is not a golem is spared where the book may not spare it, and an aberration with no head is beheaded, because the bestiary records no head.
properties.text: On a natural 20 confirmed as a critical hit, it severs the foe's head. Slashing melee weapons only.

properties.name: Brilliant Energy
not_yet: It always sheds light as a torch (20-foot radius); nothing reads light from a weapon yet.
properties.text: Its edge is light: armour and shield bonuses do not count against it, and it cannot harm undead, constructs or objects. Melee weapons, thrown weapons and ammunition only.

properties.name: Dancing
properties.reads_tag: Lane C2 (contracts §4, the last reader): loosed as a standard action, the weapon fights for 4 rounds as a scene actor at the base attack bonus of whoever loosed it, makes no attacks of opportunity, and can be caught back as a free action.
not_yet: Nothing loosens the weapon yet: dancing is lane C2's, built after the other readers. Until then the property is bound, priced and shown, and the weapon does not dance.
properties.text: Loosed as a standard action, it fights on its own for 4 rounds at the base attack bonus of the one who loosed it. Melee weapons only.

properties.name: Spell Storing
properties.reads_tag: Lane C2: holds one targeted spell of 3rd level or lower with a casting time of one standard action, cast into the creature struck as a free action, through the cast door with origin item:<id>.
not_yet: Nothing stores a spell in a weapon yet: spell storing is lane C2's. Until then the property is bound, priced and shown, and holds nothing.
properties.text: Holds one targeted spell of up to 3rd level, released into a creature the weapon hits.

properties.name: Distance
properties.text: Doubles the weapon's range increment. Ranged weapons only.

properties.name: Returning
properties.reads_tag: The thrown-weapon path asks has_state('property.returning') of the item: a returning weapon flies back to the thrower just before their next turn (Scene.out_of_hand leaves it in their hand), and catching it is a free action.
not_yet: Nothing reads property.returning yet; a thrown returning weapon lies where it fell until lane C's thrown path asks the tag.
properties.text: Thrown, it flies back to the thrower's hand just before their next turn. Thrown weapons only.

properties.name: Seeking
properties.reads_tag: The attack path's concealment roll asks has_state('property.seeking') of the weapon: a seeking weapon's attack ignores the miss chance concealment would give (the wielder still has to aim at the right square).
not_yet: Nothing reads property.seeking yet; the miss chance is still rolled until lane C's concealment roll asks the tag.
properties.text: Veers to its target: concealment gives no miss chance against it. Ranged weapons only.

properties.name: Throwing
properties.text: Can be thrown by anyone proficient with it in melee, with a range increment of 10 feet. Melee weapons only.

properties.name: Ki Focus
properties.reads_tag: The monk's ki abilities (content/class-abilities/monk.json: ki strike, stunning fist's charge `weapons`, quivering palm) ask has_state('property.ki-focus') of the weapon in hand and treat it as an unarmed strike.
not_yet: Nothing reads property.ki-focus yet; a monk's stunning fist charge still lists only unarmed strikes until lane C adds the tag to its weapons test.
properties.text: The wielder may channel ki attacks through it as if it were an unarmed strike: ki strike, stunning fist, quivering palm. Melee weapons only.

properties.name: Mighty Cleaving
properties.reads_tag: The Cleave feat's action, when it exists, asks has_state('property.mighty-cleaving') of the weapon and allows one more attack against a foe adjacent to the last and within reach.
not_yet: Cleave has no feat action yet (states-effects-tells ledger: feat actions have no find_ability branch), so mighty cleaving has nothing to extend.
properties.text: With Cleave, one more attack when the first hits, against a foe adjacent to the last and within reach. Melee weapons only.

properties.name: Light Fortification
properties.text: A 25% chance that a critical hit or sneak attack against the wearer is rolled as an ordinary hit.

properties.name: Moderate Fortification
properties.text: A 50% chance that a critical hit or sneak attack against the wearer is rolled as an ordinary hit.

properties.name: Heavy Fortification
properties.text: A 75% chance that a critical hit or sneak attack against the wearer is rolled as an ordinary hit.

properties.name: Spell Resistance (13)
not_yet: spell_resistance is recorded and not executable: the cast path rolls no caster level check against spell resistance yet (effectspec, docs/spells.md 5.1). Lane C builds the check (contracts §4, SR); until then the wearer's SR is shown and does not stop a spell.
properties.text: Spell resistance 13 while worn.

properties.name: Spell Resistance (15)
not_yet: spell_resistance is recorded and not executable: the cast path rolls no caster level check against spell resistance yet. Lane C builds the check; until then the wearer's SR is shown and does not stop a spell.
properties.text: Spell resistance 15 while worn.

properties.name: Spell Resistance (17)
not_yet: spell_resistance is recorded and not executable: the cast path rolls no caster level check against spell resistance yet. Lane C builds the check; until then the wearer's SR is shown and does not stop a spell.
properties.text: Spell resistance 17 while worn.

properties.name: Spell Resistance (19)
not_yet: spell_resistance is recorded and not executable: the cast path rolls no caster level check against spell resistance yet. Lane C builds the check; until then the wearer's SR is shown and does not stop a spell.
properties.text: Spell resistance 19 while worn.

properties.name: Energy Resistance
properties.text: Absorbs the first 10 points of one chosen energy each time the wearer would take it.

properties.name: Improved Energy Resistance
properties.text: Absorbs the first 20 points of one chosen energy each time the wearer would take it.

properties.name: Greater Energy Resistance
properties.text: Absorbs the first 30 points of one chosen energy each time the wearer would take it.

properties.name: Invulnerability
properties.text: Damage reduction 5/magic while worn.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.text: Blurs the wearer and dampens the sound around them: +5 competence on Stealth. Silent moves, the older ability, is this one in Pathfinder.

properties.name: Improved Shadow
properties.text: +10 competence on Stealth while worn.

properties.name: Greater Shadow
properties.text: +15 competence on Stealth while worn.

properties.name: Slick
properties.text: Slick as oil: +5 competence on Escape Artist.

properties.name: Improved Slick
properties.text: +10 competence on Escape Artist while worn.

properties.name: Greater Slick
properties.text: +15 competence on Escape Artist while worn.

properties.name: Glamered

documents.tell: On a word, the armour takes the look of ordinary clothes; only true seeing shows it for what it is.

not_yet: Nothing in the app sees through a disguise yet, so only the tell changes.
properties.text: On command the armour looks like ordinary clothing, until it is commanded back. Only true seeing reveals it.

properties.name: Ghost Touch (armour)
properties.reads_tag: The incorporeal attack path asks has_state('property.ghost-touch-armour') of the defender's armour and shield: their enhancement and armour bonuses count against an incorporeal creature's touch attacks; an incorporeal creature can wear it.
not_yet: Nothing reads property.ghost-touch-armour yet; an incorporeal touch still ignores the armour until lane C's incorporeal attack path asks the tag.
properties.text: Its armour and enhancement bonuses count against incorporeal creatures' touch attacks, and an incorporeal creature can wear it.

properties.name: Wild
properties.reads_tag: The druid's wild shape asks has_state('property.wild') of the worn armour and shield, and keeps their armour and enhancement bonuses while the wearer is in a wild shape.
not_yet: Nothing reads property.wild yet; wild shape drops the armour bonus as for any suit until lane C's wild shape asks the tag.
properties.text: The wearer keeps its armour and enhancement bonuses in wild shape; the armour is not seen while they are transformed.

properties.name: Etherealness
not_yet: The book's wearer stays ethereal until they choose to return; here it lasts as the spell does at caster level 13.
properties.text: Once a day, on command, the wearer becomes ethereal, as ethereal jaunt.

properties.name: Undead Controlling
not_yet: The book's budget is 26 HD of undead a day, which is one control undead at caster level 13 (2 HD per level); the book lets the wearer spend it across several commands, and here it is spent in one.
properties.text: Controls up to 26 HD of undead a day, as control undead; the control ends at dawn.

properties.name: Arrow Catching
properties.text: +1 deflection to AC against ranged attacks, and ranged attacks aimed at anyone within 5 feet of the bearer are drawn to the bearer instead.

properties.name: Arrow Deflection
properties.text: Once a round, a ranged attack that would hit the bearer is deflected on a DC 20 Reflex save, plus the attacking weapon's enhancement bonus.

properties.name: Bashing
properties.reads_tag: The shield bash's weapon row asks has_state('property.bashing') of the shield: it deals damage as a weapon two size categories larger and bashes as a +1 weapon (the book: a shield's enhancement never reaches a bash, so this is the only route).
not_yet: Nothing reads property.bashing yet; a bash deals the shield's ordinary damage until lane C's bash row asks the tag.
properties.text: A shield bash deals damage as a weapon two sizes larger, and the shield bashes as a +1 weapon.

properties.name: Blinding
properties.text: Twice a day, on command, a flash of light: everyone within 20 feet but the bearer makes a DC 14 Reflex save or is blinded for 1d4 rounds.

properties.name: Animated
properties.reads_tag: Hands accounting asks has_state('property.animated') of the shield: on command it floats beside the bearer and protects them as if held, leaving both hands free, with its penalties still applying.
not_yet: Nothing reads property.animated yet; the shield still fills a hand until lane C's hands accounting asks the tag.
properties.text: On command it floats beside the bearer and protects them as if held, leaving both hands free.

properties.name: Reflecting
not_yet: Spell turning acts during somebody else's casting, and the engine has no readied-action step to hang it on (effectspec spell_operation); the use is counted and the turning narrated until it does.
properties.text: Once a day it turns a spell back on its caster, as spell turning.

properties.name: Deflection
properties.text: A deflection bonus to AC, +1 to +5: the ring of protection.

properties.name: Natural Armour
properties.text: An enhancement to natural armour, +1 to +5: the amulet of natural armour. Does not stack with barkskin.

properties.name: Armour Bonus
properties.text: An armour bonus to AC, +1 to +8, as if wearing armour: the bracers of armour.

properties.name: Resistance
properties.text: A resistance bonus on every saving throw, +1 to +5: the cloak of resistance.

properties.name: Strength
not_yet: The book's bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn (it then counts for hit points and skill ranks); here it is a standing bonus while worn.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Strength, +2, +4 or +6: the belt of giant strength.

properties.name: Dexterity
not_yet: The book's bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn; here it is a standing bonus while worn.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Dexterity, +2, +4 or +6: the belt of incredible dexterity.

properties.name: Constitution
not_yet: The book's bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn (it then counts for hit points); here it is a standing bonus while worn.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Constitution, +2, +4 or +6: the belt of mighty constitution.

properties.name: Intelligence
not_yet: The book's headband also grants skill ranks, chosen when it is made, and its bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn; neither is modelled.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Intelligence, +2, +4 or +6: the headband of vast intelligence.

properties.name: Wisdom
not_yet: The book's bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn; here it is a standing bonus while worn.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Wisdom, +2, +4 or +6: the headband of inspired wisdom.

properties.name: Charisma
not_yet: The book's bonus becomes permanent after 24 hours worn; here it is a standing bonus while worn.
properties.text: An enhancement bonus to Charisma, +2, +4 or +6: the headband of alluring charisma.

properties.name: Skill Competence
not_yet: The book prices a competence bonus to a skill (bonus squared x 100 gp) and prints no caster level, cap or spell for a free-form one: each printed item names its own. The caster level 5, the cap at +10 and the empty spell list are house numbers, for the owner to rule.
properties.source: https://legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/magicItems/magicItemCreation.html (Table: Estimating Magic Item Gold Piece Values, skill bonus (competence))
properties.text: A competence bonus on one chosen skill, +1 to +10.
